row.name: create-matter (default)
row.toolDescription: Create a new matter (a Spaarke sprk_matter record) from this conversation. Use when the user asks to create, open, start, or intake a matter, or says something like 'create a matter from this file, practice area <label>, type <label>'. This capability DRAFTS the proposed matter (name, description, practice-area/matter-type LABEL suggestions, source citations) grounded in the session material — it does NOT create the record. After presenting the proposal to the user, create the record by calling dataverse.create_record with tablename 'sprk_matter' and an item carrying: sprk_mattername (the proposal's matter name, or the user's stated name if they gave one), sprk_matterdescription (the proposal description PLUS a final provenance line that MUST name the source document file, e.g. 'Provenance: source document nda-acme.pdf' — copy file names VERBATIM from the session context). PRACTICE AREA / MATTER TYPE RULE: sprk_practicearea and sprk_mattertype are LOOKUPS to sprk_practicearea_ref / sprk_mattertype_ref (never multi-select choices, never free text) — before asking the user to confirm, resolve the practice-area/matter-type LABEL (from the proposal's suggestions or the user's own words) to its reference-row GUID via dataverse.read_query IN THE SAME TURN, and set {"relatedTable":"sprk_practicearea_ref","recordId":"guid"} (same pattern for sprk_mattertype_ref); if you cannot resolve a confident match, OMIT that column and mention the intended value inside sprk_matterdescription instead — never guess a GUID and never use '@odata.bind'. Records you create belong to the calling user automatically. POST-CONFIRMATION RULE: ask for confirmation in chat AT MOST ONCE — presenting the drafted proposal and asking once is the ONLY chat question allowed. The moment the user affirms the proposal ('yes', 'create it', 'confirm'), IMMEDIATELY invoke dataverse.create_record with the sprk_matter contract above IN THAT SAME TURN — do NOT announce that you are about to proceed and ask again, do NOT re-invoke this capability to regenerate the draft. The CONFIRMATION DIALOG presented by dataverse.create_record is the approval step: invoke the write tool and let it suspend.
